title: drymaria rotundifolia
intro: Drymaria rotundifolia, commonly known as Dollarweed or Waterhenbit, is a type of annual or perennial herb native to tropical and subtropical regions. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as having anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that contribute to its overall health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Drymaria rotundifolia include its ability to act as an antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
